project: Q-DUET-VLM RAG Phase 9A context bottleneck diagnostic

baseline.equivalence_test: full transform returns the original selected_texts byte-for-byte and leaves selector outputs unchanged

core_invariants: Selected passage IDs and their order are unchanged.
The transformer runs only after select_passages and before Generator.generate.
No context diagnostic is passed back to retrieval, selection, or evaluation labels.
Gold answers, metric definitions, retrieval settings, and generator decoding remain fixed.
Exchange results contain scalar diagnostics only and never question, passage, prediction, or raw prompt text.

interfaces.input_schema: ordered selected passage text sequence plus generator tokenizer and optional reader spans
interfaces.output_schema: ordered transformed passage text sequence plus scalar token/span diagnostics
invariants: Output sequence length and order equal input sequence length.
Non-full modes respect a deterministic total token budget.

plugins.hypothesis: The original complete selected context is the null transformation.
plugins.resource_estimate: one tokenizer pass per selected passage; no additional model forward

plugins.hypothesis: The generator may benefit from a fixed compact head allocation instead of receiving overlong selected passages.
plugins.input_schema: ordered selected passages plus budget ratio in (0,1)
plugins.output_schema: ordered head-window passages plus scalar token counts
plugins.resource_estimate: one tokenizer pass and deterministic slicing per selected passage

plugins.hypothesis: A compact window centered on the DPR Reader answer span preserves useful evidence better than an undirected head crop.
plugins.input_schema: ordered selected passages plus aligned top reader hypotheses and budget ratio in (0,1)
plugins.output_schema: ordered centered-window passages plus scalar span diagnostics
plugins.resource_estimate: one DPR reader pass over retrieved passages plus one tokenizer pass per selected passage

composition.merge_rule: Exactly one context transformer is selected per configuration; no sequential stacking is allowed in Phase 9A.
interaction_ablations: full vs uniform_head at budget ratios 0.50 and 0.75
full vs reader_window at budget ratios 0.50 and 0.75
reader_window vs uniform_head at each matched budget

validation.baseline_equivalence: Synthetic fixture proves full mode preserves text exactly and selected passage identity/order is untouched.
tests: schema and argument validation rejects unknown transforms and invalid budgets
runner writes a compact manifest and paired summary without forbidden raw fields

reproducibility.dataset_identity: nq_open validation[200:250], Wiki-DPR psgs_w100.nq.compressed, top-50 retrieval, K=5
reproducibility.environment: runner records executable/version, git commit, resolved model ID/revision, config.json SHA-256, and output paths

limitations: This phase diagnoses context sensitivity and does not implement a selector or claim a paper contribution.
Reader span localization depends on tokenizer compatibility; fallback and clipping are explicitly measured.
The 50-question slice is a development gate and requires held-out or multi-seed confirmation before claims.
